propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() spans 408 lines (59% of runner.py) and must be decomposed along natural seams via extraction of three plain functions: interpret_failure, build_model_settings/build_usage_limits, and session guard refactor.

ProviderSession is constructed at runner.py:301 but its try-guard starts at 474, leaving lines 301-473 outside the guard and leaking an opened httpx.AsyncClient when raises occur by design (e.g. _check_tool_capability).

Each child commit must independently leave runner.py under 700 LOC to pass the headroom guard (verified per patchset), because Verified is cast per change and a red ancestor blocks the relation chain.

The extraction of interpret_failure (except spine) and build_model_settings/build_usage_limits (settings block) yields runner.py 689→647 LOC and run() 408→323 lines (-21%), while preserving all measured facts, file:line citations, and bug/story IDs.

test_execution_mode_dispatch.py::_NoBuildProviderSession stub must gain __enter__/__exit__ methods in the same commit that introduces with ProviderSession context manager to satisfy the context-manager protocol.
Eight monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, …) test targets move between modules; each child owns repointing patches for names its commit relocates, verified by running the full suite.
